title: Salted Palmetto | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
meta_description: Salted Palmetto — a house in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida. 10 guests · 4 bedrooms · 3.5 bathrooms. Book direct with Stay on 30a.
description_expanded: Welcome to Salted Palmetto, your perfect coastal escape in the heart of NatureWalk at Seagrove Beach. Designed for unforgettable 30A vacations, this beautifully appointed four-bedroom home offers the ideal blend of comfort, convenience, and adventure, making it the perfect destination for families, couples, and groups looking to experience the very best of the Emerald Coast.From the moment you arrive, you'll be greeted by the relaxed coastal atmosphere that makes 30A so special. Nestled among scenic nature trails and just minutes from the area's famous sugar-white sand beaches, Salted Palmetto provides the perfect home base for both relaxation and exploration. Whether you're spending the day at the beach, discovering local boutiques and restaurants, or simply enjoying quality time together, every detail has been thoughtfully designed to enhance your stay.Inside, you'll find spacious and inviting living areas filled with natural light and coastal charm. The open-concept layout creates a welcoming space where everyone can gather, share meals, and make lasting memories. Featuring two king suites with private ensuite bathrooms, the home offers comfort and privacy for multiple families or couples traveling together. Additional guest bedrooms provide comfortable accommodations for everyone, while the bunk room creates the perfect retreat for kids and younger guests, offering a fun and cozy space they'll love calling their own throughout the vacation.Traveling with little ones? Salted Palmetto makes family vacations easier by providing thoughtful baby essentials, including a pack-n-play, travel crib, Slumber Pod, and baby monitor. These convenient additions help lighten your packing list and allow parents to enjoy a more relaxing and stress-free stay.One of the best parts of staying at Salted Palmetto is how easy it is to explore 30A. Your stay includes a six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes, giving you the freedom to cruise to the beach, ride along scenic bike paths, and explore nearby communities like Seaside, WaterColor, and Seagrove Beach. Skip the hassle of parking and enjoy experiencing 30A the way it was meant to be explored.When you're not out enjoying the beach, take advantage of the incredible amenities NatureWalk is known for. Guests have access to resort-style pools, playgrounds, gathering spaces, and miles of walking and biking trails that wind through the beautiful natural landscape. Whether you're spending the afternoon poolside, taking a sunset bike ride, or enjoying a peaceful morning walk, the community offers something for everyone.After a day of adventure, return to Salted Palmetto to unwind on the porch, enjoy dinner with loved ones, and soak in the peaceful surroundings. From beach days and bike rides to sunset cruises on the golf cart and evenings spent making memories together, this is the kind of vacation you'll be talking about long after you return home.ACCOMMODATIONSSleeps 10 people:FIRST FLOORBedroom #1: King with EnsuiteHalf BathroomKitchen-Dining-Living-LaundrySECOND FLOORBedroom #2: Double/Double BunkBedroom #3: King With EnsuiteBedroom #4: QueenFull BathroomLiving RoomFEATURES6-Seater Golf Cart6 BikesPack-N-PlayTravel Crib (Sheets Included) + Baby Monitor + Slumber PodResort-Style Amenities at The Gathering PlacePickleball & Basketball CourtsFitness StationsTwo Dedicated Parking SpotsCovered Porch & BalconiesFully Stocked KitchenCoffee MakerSmart TVsWHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapDishwasher PodsLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed LinensPool TowelsWELCOME BUNDLECoffee GroundsCoffee Filters2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterLOCATIONNatureWalk at Seagrove is a meticulously planned 155-acre resort community encircled on all sides by Point Washington State Forest. Just a mile from the white sands of the 30A beaches, NatureWalk offers nature trails, a shallow-access pool, heated lap pool, kiddie pool, hot tub, lounge chairs, gas grills, fire pit, kitchenette, shower, restrooms, and a sheltered patio with various tables and chairs. Other NatureWalk amenities are available in the neighborhood, including pickleball courts & basketball half-courts. The Lily Lane nature trail also offers a secluded path down to the San Juan Beach Access. Local grocery shopping, dining, and fitness options are right around the corner at WaterColor Crossings.BEACH ACCESSThree access points, to the home:1. San Juan: San Juan Beach Access is located just south of Scenic 30A at the end of San Juan Street in the heart of Seagrove Beach. The easiest path to the beach is walking or riding a bike on the Lilly Lane Beach Trail to San Juan Avec and follow directly to the San Juan beach access. The trail head is just 900 ft from the home. Take a left out of the driveway of the home, turn left on to Sandgrass Blvd. Follow to Lily Ln and take a left, follow to trail head.2. Santa Clara: Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (.1 of a mile east of San Juan Beach Access). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach.3. Andalusia: Andalusia Beach Access is 100 yards south of Scenic 30A at Andalusia Avenue. There is a shower and bike parking and the dune walkover has a special shady pergola with benches, sitting on a high bluff overlooking the gulf. There is no car parking.PARKINGThis home includes 2 parking spaces on the driveway in back of the home. No parking is allowed on the street (except in marked spaces). No boats, trailers or RV's are allowed in the community.ABOUT THE AREASeagrove’s collection of lush oak trees, magnolias, and laid back, yet luxurious lifestyles makes it a favorite of longtime South Walton visitors. The landscape is complemented by its diverse mix of boutiques, casual cafes and an altogether upbeat ambiance.A stay in Seagrove is full of adventure! The proximity demands that visitors explore Deer Lake State Park and Eastern Lake, and biking along the Timpoochee Trail in Seagrove is a preferred way to get around!In Seagrove, dining at Café Thirty-A is a tradition. This South Walton favorite was one of the first to establish a foothold along Highway 30A. Not far to the west, on Highway 395, Seagrove Village Market is a must for succulent shrimp po-boys and good old nostalgia, having been part of the Seagrove community since 1949.To the east, Old Florida Fish House is the perfect place for lunch or dinner. You don’t want to miss out on their renowned sushi and live music!With plenty of shady nooks, beautiful stretches of sun-soaked beach, and lots of fun to go around, Seagrove is the perfect beach community for families looking for a classic Florida vacation vibe.Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 30 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a little over a 1 hour drive.HOUSE RULES*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.*No parties or events.*Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage.*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi.*This home must remain pet free.IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a "selfie".Other things to note
